summary: Vista Energy disclosed on Form 6-K that on August 6, 2026, it repurchased 50,000 Series A shares at MXN 1,140.82 per share, totaling approximately MXN 57.041 million, excluding fees and VAT. The repurchase was executed under authority approved at the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting, with Citi México Casa de Bolsa as broker. Post-repurchase, 110,917,402 Series A shares remain outstanding and 1,384,351 are held in treasury. This is an ongoing issuer buyback, representing a capital return to shareholders. Watch for continued repurchase activity and its impact on share count and float.
